title: session.prompt
description: Sends a prompt. queue starts it now when the engine is admitting and queues it otherwise; send_now starts it now, or arms it against the running turn, which it cancels and replaces; interject folds the text into the running turn without cancelling it, where the provider can (session capability interject). fromRow names a queued row to start instead of text (queue and send_now): the row's own text is what goes. interject takes text alone: the host refuses interject with a fromRow (-32602, bad_request; plan 027 X6).

result.description: For queue and send_now, exactly one of: the turn the prompt started, with the text it started with (a fromRow's text as the host read it, which another client may have edited); the row it became (or, for a fromRow that cannot start yet, that row unchanged); armed. For interject, {}.
